Title: Verify login fails with invalid CSRF token
Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/validate with credentials and invalid CSRF token.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with `AuthenticationException::invalidCsrfToken()`. User is not authenticated.

Title: Verify login fails with missing CSRF token
Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/validate with missing CSRF token.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with `AuthenticationException::invalidCsrfToken()`. User is not authenticated.

Title: Verify login fails with incorrect password
Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/validate with correct username and incorrect password.
Expected Result: Request is rejected. System redirects back to login page with error message. User is not authenticated.

Title: Verify login succeeds with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/validate with correct credentials and CSRF token.
Expected Result: System authenticates user successfully. Session is created and user is redirected to HomePagePath.

Title: Verify password strength validation enforces policy rules
Preconditions: System has password policies configured (e.g. requires uppercase)
Steps: 1. Send POST request to /api/v2/auth/public/validation/password with a password that violates policy.
Expected Result: API returns validation errors for policy violations. Max strength score returned is `BETTER` (not `STRONG` or `EXCELLENT`).
